sabyohāra.p: [ saṃ + vohāra. Saṃvyavahāra- sakkatapiṭaka ] (pu) Google Translate Sabbo Hara - 2 - In depth.

sabyābajjha.p: [ saha + byāpādha + ṇya. Avyābadhya. Avyāvadhya - sakkatapiṭaka. Vyāvadhya = byāvajcya. Va - kiu ba - pralyhaṅa byāpajcya - hu rupaprīḥsañña. Dhāna, ṭī, 8 - ၌kāḥ ( byābyādya=) byāpajcya ( byāpādya) byāpajja - hu pra၏ ] (ti) Google Translate (1) Those who are in poverty (suffering). (2) Distress (suffering = anger and suffering) - with - there - that. (3) (passion such as raga) flawed.

sabyāpajja.p: [ saha + byāpajja ] (ti) Google Translate Harassment - torture - prone to - anger - passion - with - existing.

sabyāpajjacitta.p: [ sabyāpajja + citta ] (ti) Google Translate A person who is cruel, abusive, angry, and passionate.

sabyāpajjha.p: [ saha + byāpajcya. Visuddhi, ṭī, cha. Sya, 2. 334-krañña့. Avyavadhya, savyāvadhya- sakkatapiṭaka. Paropariyatta-kaဲ့siu့ va-kiu pa-pru. ] (ti) Google Translate You see.

R:
sabyāpajjha：သ-ဗျာပဇ္ဈ （တိ）
ဆင်းရဲခြင်း ရှိသည်။ ကြောင့်ကြခြင်း ရှိသည်။

sabyañjana：သ-ဗျဉ္ဇန （တိ）
သဒ္ဒါနှင့် ပြည့်စုံသည်။
သဗျဉ္ဇနတော၊ သဒ္ဒါနှင့် ပြည့်စုံသောကြောင့်။
